Commentary.Commentary: So, how many overs will India take to overhaul this minuscule target? They have around 70 minutes before they go in for the break. Can they do it within that period? We will have to wait to find out.

Not a lot can be written about the Windies batting. 25 was the highest score for them in this innings. That sums up their performance with the bat. They never got used to the pace of the wicket and have been bowled out for a very low total.

Excellent bowling performance and a dismal batting display. This innings was a combination of both. Right from the word go, the Indian bowlers were on the money. Kumar and Bumrah struck early. Samuels and Hetmyer then did try to build a partnership but Jadeja broke through. He finished with a 4-fer and was the pick of the bowlers. Khaleel Ahmed also picked two and Kuldeep also had one to his name. On top of that, every bowler, bowled a maiden over, not something you see often in modern day cricket. All-in-all a performance the Indians will be very happy with.

OUT! That was as plumb as it can get! 4-fer for Jadeja and the WINDIES HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 104! Jadeja fires it on middle, it pitches and comes back in. Thomas is beaten on the inside edge and it rapped on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Thomas takes the review but Hawk Eye shows three reds.
Thomas is a goner? He has been given out LBW and he reviews. Looks plumb.
The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
On middle, kept out.
Oshane Thomas is the last man in.

OUT! what a catch! That was hit with a lot of power and to add to that, Jadhav also had to time his leap to perfection. This is tossed up by Jadeja on off, Roach hits it really well towards long off. He does not get the desired elevation. Jadhav there jumps at the right time and takes it with both hands. Three-fer for Jadeja and Windies are 9 down.
Fires it on middle, Roach works it to mid-wicket.
Flicks it through square leg for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
The googly outside off, Roach misses the sweep and is hit on the pads. Appeal but not given. Pitched outside leg.

Tosses it up around off, and it spins back in sharply. Roach tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. It lobs up towards Dhoni who takes it. The players appeal for both, a catch and an LBW but the umpire shakes his head.
FOUR! Not off the middle but the Windies won't mind. He plays the sweep shot through backward square leg and it races away. 100 up for the Windies.
Brings the sweep shot out and hits it through square leg for a run.
BEAUTY! Gives it a nice loop and lands it around off, it pitches and then turns away. Bishoo prods forward and tries to defend but is beaten by the turn.
Works it with the turn through square leg for a single.
Strokes it down to long off for a run.
Fires it on off, the ball turns away. Roach tries to defend but gets an outside edge which goes on the bounce to second slip.
Another ball which is a touch short, Roach pucnhes it towards covers for a run.
Fires it on middle, kept out.
Eased down to long on for a run. Welcomes Jadeja back into the attack with a run.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
Another leggie on middle, the batsman tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
Loopy ball on middle, defended.

NOT OUT! Yes, it is spinning down leg. Kuldeep tosses it up around off, it turns back in. Roach lunges and tries to defend. He misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Roach reviews. Replays show that it is spinning down leg. Roach survives to fight another day but not sure how long will the fight last.
Review time! Roach has been judged out LBW. He has reviewed. Is it turning too much?
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted ball on off, kept out.
Kemar Roach is in at no.10.

OUT! Paul holes out! The big shot was around the corner and it brings the end of Keemo. Kuldeep tosses it up around middle, it is the googly. Paul goes for the slog sweep but gets a top edge. It goes high up in the air towards Rayudu at long on who takes a few steps inside and catches it. First wicket for Kuldeep and the end is nigh for the Windies.
A bumper on middle, the batsman evades it.
Hits the off pole again and lands it on a length, Bishoo blocks it off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Bishoo guides it to point.
On a length outside off, the batsman guides it through point and a run is taken.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
WIDE! Good bouncer outside off, Paul tries to drag his pull but is beaten. The umpire has called it a wide as he felt it was above the batsman's head.
Shuffles across and keeps out the length ball on off.
FOUR! Swept and swept fine! Bishoo makes it into a  full toss by reaching out and then sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. Windies would love a lot more.
The leg spinner on off, the southpaw first thinks of playing at it but then seeing the ball turn away, pulls his bat out of the way.
Flighted ball on off, Bishoo times it to covers.
Eased down to long off for a run.
The googly on leg stump, the batsman tries to defend but is hit on the pads.
The big heave! Kuldeep tosses the ball above the eye line of the batsman. He gets tempted and brings out the slog sweep but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length outside off, Bishoo goes for the drive but fails to put bat to ball.
Full and on off, hit to the off side.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Devendra Bishoo is next.

OUT! Holder is gone! Now 150 looks far-fetched. Full and outside off, Holder looks to go over mid off but it rushes onto the batsman. Jason ends up giving it to Kedar Jadhav at mid off who comes forward and takes another low catch. 2nd wicket for Ahmed.
Length outside off, played to point.
Khaleel Ahmed in for another spell.
Dances down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Stroked down to long off for a run.
Floats it up on off, the batsman drives it through covers for a couple.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
And now a single to keep strike as he guides it through cover-point.

FOUR! Majestic! How good a shot was that? He played that a few balls ago and now does it again. This time though he gets a boundary for it. Uses his long reach and then smashes it through covers for a boundary.
On off, kept out.
EDGED BUT SHORT! Flatter and on off, it pitches and then turns away. Holder plays it with soft hands but inside the line. It takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to first slip.
Fires it on middle, kept out.
Pierced the gap to perfection! There were two fielders in the cover region and Holder caresses it through the gap. The slow outfield means the batsmen only run two.
Darts this straight, Paul taps it  in front of him.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call! Yadav tosses this one up on off, the ball spins back into Paul who misses his front foot defense and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. Kohli has a chat with his bowler and takes it up. Haw Eye shows us that the ball would just be clipping the leg stump. India retain their review.
An LBW review is taken up. Keemo Paul is the man in question.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, turned to the leg side.
Leg spinner on off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Wide. The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.
Gets behind the ball and plays this back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kuldeep Yadav finally gets to bowl.
Full in line of the stumps, played with a straight bat.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
On leg, flicked to the on side.
On off, played to the off side.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Darts this on leg, Holder just helps this on it's way towards the fine leg boundary. The ball races to the boundary. The umpire signals a boundary.
Keemo Paul walks out to the middle.

OUT! Short ball outside off, Allen goes for the pull. He connects but finds Jadhav at deep square leg. Kedar gets forward and takes a good catch. A well directed bouncer from Bumrah. All on Holder now to add some runs to the board.
Yorker on off, Allen does well to get bat to ball.
Milked through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, Holder goes for the drive but cannot put bat to ball.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
Played with soft hands towards point and quickly hares to the other end. Jadeja there has a shy at the non-striker's end but does not hit the target. Allen would be a goner if he hit.
Flatter and shorter on off, Holder punches it to covers.
On middle, defended.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Quicker and flatter, it comes in with the arm. Allen tries to keep it out but gets a bottom edge towards short third man. A run taken.
BEATEN! On off, pitches and turns away. Allen plays inside the line and the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Flatter and around off, it is pushed through covers for a run.
Holder plays it late down to third man and takes a run.
Slower ball around off, defended.
Around off, kept out.
Good length again around off, it comes back in late. Allen tries to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and goes towards fine leg for a run.
Good length around off, kept out.
India going in for the kill. They have brought Bumrah quite early on for his second spell.
Shortish and outside off, the batsman tries to cut but chops it towards point.
Jason has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy ball on off, Holder bunts it down.
Full and on off, driven to long off for a brace.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Beaten! Tossed up ball outside off, Fabain feels for it but gets beaten.
Off spinner on off, played to the off side.
Fabian Allen is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... taken! Half the side back in the hut and Khaleel is amongst the wickets. The short ball does the trick. A bumper and a good one on middle, Powell goes for the pull but does not get on top of the bounce. He mistimes it towards Dhawan at deep square leg. He moves in quickly and takes a good catch.
Shortish and outside off, Holder guides it uppishly down to third man for a run.
BEATEN! Needless shot there by Holder. Short and wide outside off, Holder goes for a back foot punch but is beaten.
Back of a length around off, Holder guides it to point.
On the shorter side outside off, Powell guides it through point and a run is taken.
Back of a length on off, Holder punches it through covers for a single.
Holder is off the mark straightaway. A tossed up ball on off, JH times it through covers for a run. End of another good over for India. Jadeja's figures read 4-1-11-2.
With that wicket, the players will have their drinks break! Also, the skipper, Jason Holder is the next man in.

OUT! Three reds and Hetmyer has been given his marching orders. Back-to-back failures for Shimron. That was plumb, excellent review by India. They have been poor with their reviews in this series but this was spot on. It is bowled flatter and around middle, it spins back in a touch. Hetmyer is a touch late in bringing his bat down and hence, the ball strikes the front pad first. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. After a chat with Dhoni and Jadeja. Kohli signals the 'T'. Replays roll in and they show the on-field call has to be overturned. Second wicket for Jadeja and the Windies slip further.
A huge appeal by the bowler but not given! A mid-pitch conference between Dhoni, Kohli and Jadeja and they go for the review. Hetmyer is the man in question. Looks very close.
Darts it on the pads, SH flicks it to square leg.
Flatter and a touch shorter on off, Powell punches it down to long off for a run.
Loopy ball on off, it is driven back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Hetmyer flicks it to deep backward square leg, a run taken.
Another bouncer over the stumps, Powell goes for the hook but misses.
In the air for a long time but falls safe. Short ball outside off, Powell pulls it over mid-wicket. They come back for a couple of runs. Also, the 50 up for Windies.
A bit fuller on middle and leg, turned to mid-wicket.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Over the wicket for the left-hander, on off, played to the off side.
Comes in from round the wicket and lands it on a good length on off, Powell taps it towards mid off for one.
A dot to end! SH works it with the turn towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Misfield and a boundary! Short and outside off, Hetmyer cuts it towards cover-point. Bumrah there dives over the ball and a boundary results.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
The straighter one on middle, Powell tries to defend but he gets an inside edge to short fine leg and a run is taken.
Flatter on middle, kept out.
Down the leg side, Powell tries to flick but the ball brushes the pads and goes into the mitts of the keeper. An appeal follows but nothing from the umpire.

Leading edge... but safe! Again the slowness of the wicket is quite visible there. Around a length and on middle, Powell tries to flick but closes the face of the bat a touch early. A leading edge is produced. It lobs over covers for a run.

Just short! Hetmyer has not learnt from the previous dismissals. He tries to stroke it on the up which is not a good idea on this wicket. The ball does not arrive and hence goes uppishly towards covers. It though lands just short of Kohli there. The skipper misfields and a run is taken.
Slower ball on off, Powell tries to defend but gets an outside edge to covers.
On off, defended.
Back of a length on off, Powell keeps it out.
Guided down to third man for a run.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. Wide signalled by the umpire.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Shimron Hetmyer walks out to bat.

OUT! Jadeja strikes! So just as the partnership was starting to build, India have broken through. A soft dismissal. Jadeja slows it up a touch and bowls it on middle, it pitches and comes even slower off the surface. Samuels tries to drive but due to the slowness, he is way too early into the shot. Hits the higher part of the bat and lobs towards covers. Kohli there runs forward and takes it easily. Samuels once again does not make an impact and his poor series comes to an end.
On the pads, Powell works it through mid-wicket for a single.
A touch short and the ball straightens. Powell works it to mid-wicket.
Slightly slower through the air on off, Samuels guides it through cover-point and takes a run.
Fires it on middle, defended.
Short ball, pulled away to deep square leg for one.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot to the off side.
In the air for some time but safe. Ahmed cramps Powell for room. Rovman just chips it towards mid-wicket. But it falls safe. They cross.
Short ball on middle and leg, MS goes for the pull but fails to get bat to ball. The ball hits the batsman and rolls past the keeper where they steal a leg bye.
Guided to deep backward point to change ends.
Length on off, blocked to the off side.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
A dot to end! So Jadeja strats off with a maiden. Fires it on off, gets it to turn a touch. Samuels guides it to point.
Flighted ball on off, driven to covers.
On the stumps, kept out.
Floats it up outside off, Samuels once again goes for a drive with hard hands, gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tosses this up on middle, MS goes hard at it but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Bowls it around leg and gets it to straighten a touch. Samuels lunges and keeps it out.
Ravindra Jadeja is into the attack. Spinner for the first time today.
Edged and a run! Short and outside off, the batsman throws his bat at it, gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
A bumper, good change in length there but it bounces a little too high. Wided.
On the pads again, Marlon misses out there as he finds short fine leg with his flick shot.
FOUR! Expensive start from Khaleel. It is a little too straight and Marlon whips it uppishly but in the gap through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length around off, Samuels defends it out.

SIX! That has been tonked! As straight as it can get. Full and width on offer, Samuels gets an opportunity to free his arms and does so brilliantly. Lofts it over the bowler's head for a maximum. Runs now starting to come.
Starts off with a beauty! A yorker on middle, Samuels gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Khaleel Ahmed is into the attack. He was brilliant in the last game. Can he do something similar?
Yes, a dot to end! Around off, the batter guides it to point.
On a length and around off, kept out. 5 dots in a row. Maiden?
Back of a length around off, guided to point.
Now gets this one to jag back in. Powell is solid in defense.
Beaten for the second time in a row! Another beauty! Similar like the last one. Angled in and then moves away late. Powell plays the original trajectory but is beaten by the late movement.

A superb nut! Another ball angled into the batsman and then leaves him. Powell plays inside the line and gets beaten. Not a lot you can do with that delivery. Just hope that it beats the outside edge.

Once again it is a little too straight. Samuels finds the fielder at mid-wicket with his flick. The batsman would feel he has missed out on anther scoring opportunity there. Nevertheless, a good over for the visitors.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is even better than the last one. Fullish and on middle, MS whips it through wide mid on and the ball races away. A good over this for the Windies.
FOUR! Lovely shot this! Fuller in length around off, Samuels leans into it and times it through mid off. The ball races away.
Around off, guided to point.
Another ball on a back of a length around middle, Samuels tries to defend it by taking one hand off the handle. The ball takes the inside edge and hits him on the pads.
A muted appeal! On the pads, Samuels goes for the flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. Kumar appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Back of a length around off, Powell goes back and keeps it out.
Down the leg side, Powell tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball goes to the keeper.
Excellent comeback by Bumrah. He bowls a beauty. First angles it into the batter which means Powell has to play at it. Then the ball leaves him and beats the outside edge.
FOUR! First of the game and what a shot that is! Slightly fuller in length around off, Powell lofts it with a very straight bat over mid off and into the boundary.
Good length around off, kept out.
The sucker ball outside off, Powell though is not sucked into the shot and he makes a leave.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. End of another tight over.
Attacks the off pole, Samuels is solid in defense.
But he will look to score of the bad balls, on the fuller side and width on offer. Samuels throws his bat at it, gets it through cover-point. The outfield is not that fast and two taken.
A little too wide outside off, left alone. So Samuels is showing good patience here. He is looking to play himself in, get used to the pace of the surface.
On the off pole, it comes slow off the surface. Samuels mistimes his drive to mid off.
Good length around off, Marlon keeps it out.
A single to end the over! On the pads, clipped down to fine leg for a run.

That is exactly why the third slip was brought in! Bumrah slips in the outswinger and lands it around off, the batsman has to play with it but the away movement takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to the third slip fielder. Samuels had played that with soft hands and hence it did not carry.
Once again it is a little too wide outside off, MS makes another leave.
Good length outside off, the batsman shoulders arms.
The in-dipper now, this is very good bowling from Bumrah. It shapes in and Samuels pushes it to mid on.

Good delivery! But not sure if Samuels needed to play at that. He is shuffling too across and hence he was dragged into the stroke. On a length and outside off, it pitches and shapes away. Marlon plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Again, hits the length around off, Powell tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. A dot to end and it is a maiden from Kumar.
Back of a length around off, Powell goes back and pushes it to covers.
This time gets it to swing into the batsman as it is bowled a touch fuller. Rovman is solid in defense.
Good length outside off, trying to shape it back in but no swing available. Left alone.
A little too straight on middle, Powell flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length and around middle, kept out.
Good leave! This one also come back in late from outside off. Samuels watchfully lets it be. End of another successful over.
Outside off, it is too early in Samuels innings to go after it.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Samuels tries to flick but misses.

OUT! TIMBER! India have two in the opening two overs. Both the new ball bowlers have struck and this is probably the wicket India would have wanted desperately. The man in form, Shai Hope, walks back without troubling the scorers. What a peach to get him. Just ahead of a driving length and it comes back in very late and a long way. Hope makes the mistake of going for a drive away form his body. The ball hits the inside edge and disturbs the furniture behind. Bumrah is ecstatic and Windies are in big trouble here.
A little too wide outside off, tempting the batsman to go for a loose stroke. Hope is not tempted and he makes a leave.
Slightly shorter in length and on middle, Hope hops and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Powell is underway as he guides this down to third man for a single.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.
Length again and it goes straight on after pitching. Hope guides it towards gully. Good field position as this takes out that dab shot down to third man.
Slightly fuller in length on off, no swing on offer this time. Hope strokes it to mid off.
Shai Hope is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! The crowd here erupts as Kumar has struck in the very first over. Powell walks back for a duck and once again Windies are dealt a blow early on. Brilliantly set up that one, after a few inswingers he bowls the away swinger. Lands it on a length around off, Powell goes for the drive away from his body. He also tries to hit it on the up but it is not on a driving length. Not clever so early in your innings and also when the ball is doing a bit. It takes the outside edge and goes towards Dhoni who takes it by diving to his left.
Angles this across the batsman from around off, Powell punches it to covers.
Another in-dipper but the ball is on the pads. Powell tries to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Windies are up and running, courtesy an extra. An inswinger down the leg side. Wide given.

Well intent straightaway from Powell. He gives Kumar the charge. Also, encouraging sings for BK as he gets the ball to shape back in. The line though is down the leg side, Powell misses he flick to get hit on the pads.

We are all set for the action to begin. The Indian players make their way out to the middle. A surprise at the top as Rovman Powell is opening the innings. Kieran Powell is his partner. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will open the bowling for India. It is overcast here so he might just get some swing. Two slips in place. Here we go...
Big news for Indian fans, Rahul Dravid fans in particular. He has been officially inducted into the ICC Hall Of Fame.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli, says they would have bowled first as dew might just play a part later on. Mentions it is overcast so the surface will have something in it in the initial overs and the spinners will come into play later on. informs they are unchanged.

Windies skipper, Jason Holder, says the wicket looks a little dry. Mentions they hope to defend after putting up a good score. Informs they have two changes, Nurse and Hemraj go out for Thomas and Bishoo. Adds further that Nurse has been ruled out for the whole tour due to an injury and he hopes he recovers as soon as possible. Admits they need to be more consistent. Ends by saying they have shown glimpses of what they can produce in this tour.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of the Windies. They will bat first.

The Greenfield stadium is all set to host it's first ODI match. This will be the 47th stadium in India to host one. A lot is at stake here. For India they have a chance to seal the series. They have momentum on their side and they would look to carry forward it in this game. Windies on the other hand, will be eager to win here. A victory will see them level the series. It though will be interesting to see if they have recovered from the battering they got in the last game. Who will come out on top? Stay tuned to find out. Welcome to the coverage.
